text.text_excerpt: I've been told that this place is rather overpriced and that the portions are really small, so I've avoided it in the last two years living here. I finally went due to it's proximity to my new house, and I agree that this is an issue with Hillel. However, after I've sampled a few plates, the food can be deliciously fresh AND filling if you order correctly. I've found that the most bang-for-your-buck option is to get a burrito, as they're the same price as other meals but much larger in size. The last time I went I had the Xavier burrito, which contained a pulled-pork-like beef and was very delicious. Overall, I'm sure I'll keep coming here for lunch so long as I live so close!

This place offers really good quality, clean food at good prices. I appreciate organic and grass fed options and this place offers just that. You can tell alot of thought has been put into making the dishes they offer ... I had the PASTRAMI SANDWICH for lunch and it was very delicious; just the right amount of crunch from the toasts, the homemade pastrami is not too salty and just oily enough to keep the sandwich moist. The CINNIMON ROLL is also great--there were walnuts and apples baked inside. It might also be useful to note that they have a lot of vegan and kosher options. My good friend Tyler is vegan and comes here all the time. Great study spot, especially during the summer before Tulane reopens.
